verdict.rationale: An in-product assistant (for example, a console copilot that runs tasks for the user) is a fair question for an inference and training platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows such an assistant. The function-calling and agent-loop docs are APIs for building your own agents, and the agent skills and docs MCP server equip external coding agents in your editor rather than providing a built-in assistant to delegate to.
